comments.text: Nepal is far more than Mount Everest — behind the famous Himalayan landscapes are stories, traditions, and realities that most travelers never see. 🏔 This travel documentary explores a deeper side of Nepal, where opportunity, culture, and risk often exist closer together than they first appear. Which part of Nepal’s story changed the way you see this country the most? Share your thoughts below and subscribe for more travel documentaries from around the world. #Nepal #TravelDocumentary #Everest #Himalayas
